name: Agency Relations Manager
description: Owns agency and broker relationship governance across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, shaping distribution operating-model design and delegated authority oversight. Supports producer pipelines and training, logs bound submission outcomes in the CRM, tracks corrective actions to closure, and secures compliance sign-off on partner-facing materials.

name: Analytics Lead
description: Leads actuarial analytics delivery, spanning financial reporting, triangle construction, and prior-year development analysis within the Actuarial value stream. Screens triangle data for anomalies, applies RBC formulas for economic capital modeling, produces PML regulatory disclosures, and reports actual versus projected capital to the Board using actuarial modeling platforms and the enterprise data warehouse.

name: Annuity Service Specialist
description: Handles end-to-end complaint resolution within the Call Center value stream, from formal intake and investigation through corrective action and closure. Performs root-cause analysis, calculates complaint ratios against benchmarks, drafts regulatory-compliant response letters, and flags bad-faith or litigation-risk complaints for escalation and regulatory reporting.

name: Annuity Suitability Analyst
description: Performs replacement suitability reviews and underwriting quality assurance within the Underwriting value stream. Administers reinsurance program tasks including bordereaux preparation and over-retention referrals, manages appetite guidelines and exception tracking, supports policy binding and mid-term endorsements, and reports portfolio concentration and appetite status to committee.

name: Application Security Lead
description: Leads application security across the Cybersecurity & IAM value stream, covering container security, web application firewall management, and security hardening. Prioritizes vulnerability risk, tracks patch remediation including emergency deployments for exploited vulnerabilities, audits privileged activity, and manages data security controls including enterprise encryption key lifecycle on the IAM and GRC platforms.

name: Appointed Actuary
description: Owns the statutory actuarial opinion and Board actuarial reporting within the Actuarial value stream. Monitors reserve development and prior-year development analysis, incorporates stress outcomes into ORSA and ICAAP, benchmarks tail factor selections against industry schedules, and responds to Board and Audit Committee questions using actuarial modeling platforms and the model governance repository.

name: Audit Analyst
description: Executes audit engagements within the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, applying data analytics and risk-based planning. Scores auditable entities by risk, documents process and control walkthroughs, agrees management action plans, validates remediation evidence before closing findings, and contributes to quarterly Audit Committee reporting and the quality assurance programme.

name: Auto Claims Specialist
description: Manages ongoing auto claim files within the Claims value stream, covering liability evaluation, denial management, and release agreement handling. Documents liability decisions in the claims platform, monitors workflow routing and rebalances misrouted claims, places structured settlements, and maintains vendor network directories and routing rules.

name: BI / Analytics Manager
description: Oversees actuarial reporting analytics across the Actuarial value stream, including triangle construction, prior-year development analysis, and actuarial data quality management. Validates prior-period restatements, applies RBC formulas for internal economic capital modeling, produces PML regulatory disclosures, and reports capital results against plan to the Board via actuarial modeling and data warehouse platforms.

name: BI Developer
description: Builds curated reporting datasets, dashboards, and regulatory reporting analytics within the Data & AI value stream. Develops advanced statistical models, reconciles dashboard figures to source, governs metric definitions through change control and the metric catalog, and enables self-service analytics through a certified component and template library on the BI platform.

name: Backend Developer
description: Develops and delivers solution builds and integrations within the Technology & Engineering value stream, including real-time data engineering and pipeline orchestration. Operates the API gateway, governs API design standards, executes system integration test cycles, implements pipeline retry and failure-recovery handlers, and maintains engineering knowledge through documentation and sharing sessions.

name: Benefits Administrator
description: Administers employee benefits within the Human Resources & Talent value stream, covering open enrollment, leave management, retirement programs, and voluntary benefits. Configures plan designs and rates in the HRIS, validates leave eligibility, documents workplace accommodation decisions, benchmarks plans against market data, and manages carrier relationships.

name: Benefits Analyst
description: Owns benefits identification and realization tracking within the Program Management Office value stream. Catalogues candidate benefits from business cases, maps dependencies into realization timelines, designs the benefits measurement framework and dashboard, raises corrective actions for below-trajectory benefits, and conducts twelve-month post-implementation reviews for governance reporting.
